system.description:
Snap your shield forward, a solid crack to the ribs or jaw.

  • Once per round, when you hit a creature no more than one size larger than you with a melee attack while holding a shield, slam the shield in as part of the same attack.
  • The target makes a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half your level (minimum 1) + your Strength modifier) or is knocked Prone.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

activities.name: Shield Bash
activities.text: After a melee hit while holding a shield, on a creature no more than one size larger: Fortitude save or knocked Prone.
